label: Local Reaper pieces co-possible along every coinitial populated descent
term: possible local Reaper pieces along coinitial descents
definition: CoinitialReaperPiecesPossible R h Concrete w is ReaperPiecesPossible restricted to coinitial descents: in every history v accessible from w, along every strictly descending sequence c that runs below every moment earlier than its populated first moment, every two adjacent local pieces are realized together in some world accessible from v. In ordinary language: if the past of a populated moment goes back without beginning, a possible Reaper trio fits at any three consecutive members of a sequence running back through it, such as one station per past day.
note: Weak version of ReaperPiecesPossible (coinitialPiecesOfPieces). It says nothing about a past with a beginning, so it is silent about dense time with a first moment. Analyst formulation; attribution deferred. OPEN.
